data.content: Implementation commit a1878944c2d41a4f184b179d9824de4fcea5490f. Branch: codex/knots-075e-protected-v2. Protected protocol-v2 authority is isolated under .knots/v2 with canonical/control/archive/inbox refs, lossless raw-pack and exact event indexes, monotonic activation/recovery records, provider-marker validation, and fail-closed local deletion. Legacy v0.17.6 writes cannot alter canonical v2 state. Validation: cargo test compaction (10 passed), cargo test --test v0176_compaction_compat (1 passed), make lint, make install-hooks, and make sanity (1,307 unit tests plus all integration targets; 95.03% coverage). Sneka attribution note published.
